'''thekramer RTP... I Hope''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[thekramer]]
* '''Published:''' 30 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rescue The Princess|SE-L-rescuetheprincess.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Rescue The Princess
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 RTP thekramer LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Well im kinda new to this whole rtp thing, I usually play hidden base, but i wanted to try something new so any and all comments are greatly appreciated.  Thanks for your help.

The published list has 69 cards.

== Strategy ==

well artoo rescues the princess, im thinking of adding lift tubes + escapes, should i.  Then u try to set up the fantastic four while draining and retrieving as necessary.  Han shoots people and the adders should put the hurt on the opponant.

this deck is really untested and i can use any help you can give.  Thanks
